# Domain contract: delivery-topology

- **API version:** `delivery.example.org/v1alpha1`
- **Definition source:** `domains/delivery-topology.yaml`

## Normalized schema and policy

```yaml
apiVersion: delivery.example.org/v1alpha1
kinds:
    Deployment:
        required:
            - service
            - environment
            - purpose
        properties:
            environment:
                type: ref
                refKind: Environment
            purpose:
                type: string
            service:
                type: ref
                refKind: Service
    Environment:
        required:
            - product
            - purpose
        properties:
            product:
                type: ref
                refKind: Product
            purpose:
                type: string
    Product:
        required:
            - purpose
        properties:
            purpose:
                type: string
    Service:
        required:
            - product
            - purpose
        properties:
            product:
                type: ref
                refKind: Product
            purpose:
                type: string
relations:
    belongsToProduct:
        description: Services and Environments independently name their Product owner.
        field: product
        sourceKinds:
            - Service
            - Environment
        targetKinds:
            - Product
        minTargets: 1
        maxTargets: 1
    deploysService:
        description: A Deployment names the Service being delivered.
        field: service
        sourceKinds:
            - Deployment
        targetKinds:
            - Service
        minTargets: 1
        maxTargets: 1
        context: true
    deploysTo:
        description: A Deployment names its target Environment.
        field: environment
        sourceKinds:
            - Deployment
        targetKinds:
            - Environment
        minTargets: 1
        maxTargets: 1
        context: true
constraints:
    - name: deployment-service-and-environment-share-product
      description: The selected Service and Environment must resolve to the same Product.
      select:
        kind: Deployment
      assert:
        op: same-target
        left:
            - deploysService
            - belongsToProduct
        right:
            - deploysTo
            - belongsToProduct
```
